evidence: The preflight reads a server list from the private home this run built; its verdict is checked against the packet server's exact interpreter, script, packet path and digest, none of which depend on the working directory.
The inference step is the one that must not see a workspace, and it is the one that carries -C into a run-scoped empty directory.
Aligning both invocations is a small change that would invalidate the rounds binding this candidate; it is recorded as a follow-up.
